ModelName.description:
Finite set of OpenCLIP checkpoints — a selector in the UI.

Both are 512-d so a job's index dimension is fixed and search always
operates within one model's vector space. The value is `<arch>/<pretrained>`;
the encoder splits it on `/` when loading (see service/openclip_model.py).

A short-lived presigned PUT the browser uploads to, plus the exact
headers it must send. `Content-Length` and `content-type` are signed into
the URL, so B2 rejects a body of any other size or type.
PresignUploadResponse.title: PresignUploadResponse

info.description: Local API for OpenCLIP Batch Embeddings — a batch image/text embedding pipeline that streams a corpus from Backblaze B2, encodes it on-device with OpenCLIP, and writes .npy embedding shards and a FAISS index back to B2. This contract documents the app's local API, not a hosted public endpoint.
info.title: OpenCLIP Batch Embeddings API

get.description:
Rich metadata (checksums, image/PDF fields) recomputed on demand.

Unlike /metadata (a cheap head_object), this downloads the object to
re-run extraction, so it is billed at the tighter 'write' rate-limit tier
(see runtime/ratelimit.py) to bound egress/cost amplification.

post.description:
Marquee action: stream → encode → write shards → build+upload index.

Returns the updated job (status `complete` or `failed`); a pipeline error is
recorded on the manifest rather than 500ing.

get.description: Embedding-pipeline metrics, write-amplification projection, and throughput.

post.description: Text → nearest corpus images within one job's OpenCLIP/FAISS vector space.

Validate a declared upload and hand back a presigned PUT.

The browser uploads the bytes straight to B2 with the returned URL, so they
never traverse this Function — that is what lifts Vercel's ~4.5 MB payload
ceiling. Size and content-type are signed into the URL (see the service).
Confirm an object just uploaded directly to B2 is valid and visible.
